```python
from functions import perform_web_search
import re

def extract_years_kya(snippet):
    nums = [int(x.replace(',', '')) for x in re.findall(r"\b\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})\b", snippet)]
    # return values in thousands of years
    return [n//1000 for n in nums if n > 1000]

query = "Bizmoune Cave shell beads abstract Science Advances 2021"
results = perform_web_search(query, count=8)
print(results)

# collate numbers from snippets
all_kya = []
for r in results:
    snip = r.get('snippet','')
    all_kya.extend(extract_years_kya(snip))

# deduplicate and sort
unique_kya = sorted(set(all_kya))
print({"ages_kya": unique_kya, "min_kya": min(unique_kya) if unique_kya else None, "max_kya": max(unique_kya) if unique_kya else None})
```
